description: This file defines the BinaryValue class used to represent a DynamoDB binary (B) value within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for initializing the object with a binary value, serializing it to JSON, and converting it to a string.

classes.name: BinaryValue
classes.description: Represents a DynamoDB binary (B) value with methods for serialization and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BinaryValue object, converting input to a string stream if necessary.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the binary value for JSON serialization.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the binary value as a string.
